subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should TUI delivery gain a persistent config default, and what canonical config shape should own it?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces, and current docs intentionally describe delivery as launch-fixed rather than a setting.

options.title: Approve narrow config default
options.body: Add a canonical `tui.deliver`-style opt-in default read by the TUI CLI, with schema/docs/tests and explicit flag precedence.

options.title: Keep launch-only delivery
options.body: Leave `--deliver` as the only persistent mechanism and improve docs or first-run guidance instead of adding config surface.

options.title: Design a session/UI preference
options.body: Treat delivery as a TUI/session preference rather than an `openclaw.json` key, which needs broader UX design first.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow config default
recommendation.body: Add a canonical `tui.deliver`-style opt-in default read by the TUI CLI, with schema/docs/tests and explicit flag precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to this person as the original and recurring TUI/CLI/config contributor, and the decision is about product-level config policy rather than a narrow code defect.
